internal_operations.why: Machine protocol for external AI tools; user feature is AI-04
Inbound webhooks and polling; user effect is items arriving in the inbox (DOC-*)
Background jobs run by the scheduler; manual run is owner-only maintenance
Engine endpoints consumed by Books screens; covered through BK-* and SAL-* outcomes
Generic proposal entry points behind every draft; covered through feature cases
The client’s own application (clients are not staff); requires emailed one-time code, covered separately by CP cases that need an email inbox
Advanced accounting set-up not reachable without finance experience; listed for later wave
